verdict.rationale: Open-source contribution is a fair question for a desktop LLM runtime, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented contribution process, contributor guide, or recognition path. Several community reports say the LM Studio app and Bionic are closed source, and a mention of filing a GitHub issue is an adjacent bug-reporting channel, not a code-contribution process.

support.subject: As a developer, I can contribute code and become a recognized collaborator through the project's open-source process
